dialogues.speaker: Zaretsky
dialogues.text: The High Table... the gangs... There really are too many things to deal with...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you talking about, anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Zaretsky
dialogues.text: Hm? Me? Did I say something? Haha, you must have misheard. ...*sigh* Uh... I was only talking about... some of the messes the former Chairperson left behind.

dialogues.speaker: Zaretsky
dialogues.text: The former Chairperson's passing was... rather sudden. The new acting president still hasn't had time to fully get a handle on everything that comes with the position.

dialogues.speaker: Zaretsky
dialogues.text: And perhaps there are responsibilities that she simply isn't in a position to take on yet. So for now, certain matters have fallen to those of us further down the ladder...

dialogues.speaker: Zaretsky
dialogues.text: That's very kind of you, my friend. But not every job can be handed off to someone else. Otherwise, there'd be far fewer people in this world losing sleep over work.
